about: Lethal League Blaze is an intense, high speed ball game, with unique characters and out of sight sounds.
The goal is to hit your opponent with an anti-gravity ball using strikes, bunts, parries, throws and special abilities.
The balls speeds up on every hit, up to reality-breaking velocities.
Play locally AND online with up to 4 players. Turn on power-ups to really get the chaos going.
Play Free-For-All, Strikers, Teams, Lethal Volley or step up to the plate by yourself and try the Arcade mode or the event-based Story mode.
Discover the true competitive gameplay and invite friends for a Private Match or head straight into a Quick Match.
An off the wall soundtrack containing the likes of Hideki Naganuma, Frank Klepacki, Pixelord, Bignic and, of course, Klaus Veen.
summary: Lethal League Blaze is an intense, high speed ball game, with unique characters and out of sight sounds.
